Your units don't exactly take cover and press their backs against big objects, instead you move behind any object you find then order your unit to crouch, so there is no direct interaction between the two, but your units can hover over objects that are waist-high, and it seems that the AI is smart enough to hide behind objects and crouch too if it wants you to have a hard time hitting its units

You can enter tactical view which shows you the entire map in 3d, so you can know where are your members, enemy members, chests and other things you can use, as well as choke points

There are environmental traps you can activate, or proximity bombs you can set as well as barricades and gas canisters that certain types of unit can set anywhere

And off course the game has different types of units, snipers brawlers, technicians... Etc each with its own abilities and stats
